description: This file defines an API service module for a React frontend, providing functions for authentication, dashboard data, video management, and analytics, with support for mock API usage.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Configures the bearer token for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, optionally using mock API.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with name, email, and password, optionally using mock API.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Fetches dashboard summary statistics and latest activity, optionally using mock API.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists videos with statuses, optionally using mock API.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads a new video file, optionally using mock API.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific video.

methods.name: getSheet
methods.description: Fetches sheet metadata or link for a video.
